sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Humanizer is a skill for AI agents that rewrites AI-sounding text so it reads like a person wrote it, without changing what it says. It is based on Wikipedia's guide to signs of AI writing and checks for 26 patterns.
sixtySeconds.problem: AI-written text has recognisable tells, like 'it's not just X, it's Y' or dramatic one-line closers, that make readers tune out. Humanizer finds and rewrites those patterns, and can match your own writing voice from a sample.
whoFor: Writers and marketers editing AI drafts
Developers writing docs and posts with AI
Claude Code, Codex and pi users
Anyone who wants clearer, plainer prose
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it to edit AI drafts for human readers. The README is clear that it does not try to beat AI detectors, and detectors still flag most of its output.
requirements: An AI agent that supports skills: Claude Code 2.1.142+, Codex, pi, Claude.ai, Claude Desktop or others

overview: Humanizer is a skill file you install into your agent and run with /humanizer, or by asking in plain language to humanize some text or a file. It reads a file in full before editing and summarises which sections it reviewed.

It targets 26 patterns, with five strongest tells: 'not X but Y' framing, one-line closers, sayings that sound deep, staged run-ups like 'Here's the thing', and arguing with no one. The README reports that judges preferred its rewrite over the original AI text 16 times out of 16 in a blind test.

To match your voice, include two or three paragraphs of your own writing; it follows the sample's rhythm, word choice and punctuation. It installs through the Claude Code plugin marketplace, the skills CLI for Codex and other agents, pi, or as a ZIP upload in Claude.ai and Claude Desktop.

setup: 2 to 3 paragraphs of your own writing

steps.title: Run the skill with a voice sample
steps.code:
/humanizer
Here's a sample of my writing for voice matching:
[paste 2-3 paragraphs of your own writing]
Now humanize this text:
[paste AI text to humanize]

troubleshooting.problem: Plugin install fails in Claude Code
troubleshooting.solution: The plugin needs Claude Code 2.1.142+; on older versions run npx skills add blader/humanizer --global --agent claude-code.

troubleshooting.problem: Want it in one project only
AI detectors still flag the text
troubleshooting.solution: Expected; Humanizer edits for human readers, not detectors.
